name: Hangzhou DPtech Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou DPtech Technologies Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiary, engages in the development and sale of network and information security software in China, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company offers network security products, such as application firewall, intelligent security gateway, intrusion prevention system, web application firewall, anti-DDoS system, IoT security control system, and industrial firewall; INSIGHT, a cybersecurity detection platform; network security risk management and control platform; and cybersecurity situation awareness platform.
